# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v2.0.0

这一版解决一个很实际的问题：**灵感来了想配一张截图说明，但这些图不能无限堆在资源库里。**

现在「本次行动细则」可以直接粘贴或拖入图片（原分辨率存入思源资源库，细则里只留路径引用）；条目结束后，它和它所有下级引用的图片进入 **7 天待清理宽限期**，到期后在独立页面里逐条逐张勾选确认，才真正删除——而且只删思源确认「没有任何引用」的文件。同一页面还提供「图库体检」，随时能看到行舟图片有多少、占了多少。

## 主要更新

- **行动细则支持图片**：直接在细则编辑框粘贴截图（⌘/Ctrl+V），或把图片文件拖到卡片上；图片按**原分辨率**存入思源资源库，不重编码、不压缩，细则里只保留 `assets/…` 路径引用，图片字节不进入插件数据（避免被轮换备份与云同步成倍放大）。同一张图片重复粘贴只存一份——按内容指纹命名，思源内核也会按内容复用已有资源。
- **编辑态与阅读态都有反馈**：输入框下方显示缩略图，包含上传中菊花、失败标红、体积角标与单张移除；阅读态按容器宽度限高完整显示（长截图不被裁切、不被拉伸），点击可看原图。
- **条目结束即登记待清理**：把该条目与**所有下级**引用的图片登记进队列，进入 7 天宽限期。宽限期内细则与图片原样保留，条目上显示「图片待清理 · 还剩 N 天」角标，到期的条目在清理页排在最前并高亮。
- **新增「图片清理」页面**（工具栏入口，带待清理条数角标）：
  - 列出所有待清理条目：缩略图、张数、状态、倒计时；
  - 点「现在清理」进入**页内确认步骤**，逐条、逐张勾选范围；被其它未结束条目引用的图片会标明引用方，且不允许勾选；
  - 确认后**先摘掉行舟的图片引用**，再逐张核对思源的「未引用资源」列表，只删除思源确认无人引用的文件；被文档、数据库或其它插件引用的图片一律保留；
  - 删除走思源单张删除接口，**文件会先进思源历史目录**，可在「历史」里找回；结果（删除数、保留数、失败原因）直接显示在页面上。
- **新增「图库体检」**：统计行舟引用的去重图片数、未结束条目占用、待清理占用与资源库总量，并给出分段占用条与按条目占用排行（可折叠，最多 20 条）。体积通过思源资源接口逐个查询并缓存，可手动重新统计。

## 修复与体验改进

- **修复一次会影响所有写入的严重问题**：新增的图片清理字段只加在了解析器上、漏了新建对象，导致「写入的数据 ≠ 重新读出的数据」，所有新建与保存都被数据完整性复核拦下并报错。现在新建对象会显式初始化该字段；复核失败时错误信息会指出首个不一致位置，便于定位。
- 修复多张图片连续粘贴时后一张插进前一张语法中间、把图片切碎的问题（光标偏移方向算反）。
- 修复连续图片之间多出空行的问题。
- 修复上传未完成时失焦保存会把半成品路径写进条目的问题：现在不写入，并移除未完成占位符。
- 修复上传未完成时切换条目、迟到的上传结果写进新条目的竞态（加入草稿归属与过期判断）。
- 修复勾选后取消、无法再次勾选的问题（勾选状态原先从派生值反推）；并修复「不可删除」误标——可删除与否只由「是否被其它未结束条目引用」决定，与勾选无关。
- 清理入口从「工具栏下方常驻面板」改为「工具栏按钮 + 独立页面」：不再占用纵向空间，也不再受弹窗宽度限制（弹窗内容曾出现右侧大片空白与文字截断）。
- 缩略图按原始比例完整显示，勾选框独立放在缩略图上方，点缩略图本身也能切换是否删除；文案固定为「删除／不可删除」，不再随勾选状态变化而产生歧义。

## 升级说明

现有工作项、执行切片、生活节律、Checklist 与营养数据均兼容，无需手动迁移。本版新增的图片登记写在既有工作项结构的新字段里（`imageCleanup`），旧数据读取时会自动补默认值；图片保存在思源资源库（`data/assets/`），会随思源云同步计入云端配额。

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v2.0.0

This release answers a practical problem: **you want a screenshot next to a thought, but those images cannot pile up in the asset library forever.**

Current Action Details now accepts pasted or dropped images (kept at original resolution in the SiYuan asset library, with only a path reference in the action text). When an item ends, the images referenced by it and all its descendants enter a **7-day cleanup grace period**; after that you confirm scope item by item and image by image on a dedicated page, and only files SiYuan considers unreferenced are deleted. The same page provides Storage Health, so you can always see how many images Xingzhou references and how much space they take.

## Highlights

- **Images in Current Action Details**: paste a screenshot (Cmd/Ctrl+V) or drop an image file on the card. Images are stored at **original resolution** — no re-encoding, no compression — and the action text keeps only an `assets/...` path reference, so image bytes never enter the plugin data (where rotating backups and cloud sync would multiply them). Identical content is stored once: assets are named after their content fingerprint, and the SiYuan kernel itself reuses existing assets by content.
- **Feedback in both modes**: edit mode shows thumbnails below the input with an upload spinner, a red failure state, a size badge and per-image removal; read mode shows images complete and capped in height (tall screenshots are neither cropped nor stretched) and opens the original on click.
- **Cleanup is registered as soon as an item ends**: the item plus **all its descendants** are queued with a 7-day grace period. During the grace period text and images stay untouched, and the item shows an "image cleanup · N days left" badge; due items sort first and are highlighted on the cleanup page.
- **New "Image cleanup" page** (toolbar entry with a pending-count badge):
  - Lists every pending item with thumbnails, image count, status and countdown;
  - "Clean up now" opens an **in-page confirmation step** to select items and individual images; images still referenced by other unfinished items show the referencing item and cannot be selected;
  - After confirmation Xingzhou **removes its own references first**, then checks SiYuan's "unreferenced assets" list and deletes only files SiYuan considers unused. Images referenced by documents, databases or other plugins are always kept;
  - Deletion goes through SiYuan's single-asset API, which **copies the file into the history folder first** so it can be recovered from History; the result (deleted, kept, failures) is shown on the page.
- **New "Storage Health"**: counts distinct images referenced by Xingzhou, usage of unfinished items, pending usage and whole-library size, with a segmented usage bar and a per-item usage ranking (collapsible, top 20). Sizes are queried through SiYuan's asset API and cached, and can be refreshed manually.

## Fixes and polish

- **Fixed a severe issue that affected every write**: the new cleanup field was added to the parser but missed on newly created items, so "written data ≠ re-read data" and every create/save was rejected by the data integrity re-check. New items now initialise the field explicitly, and the error message reports the first differing position when a re-check fails.
- Fixed pasting several images in a row inserting the next image into the middle of the previous image syntax and splitting it (cursor offset computed in the wrong direction).
- Fixed blank lines appearing between consecutive images.
- Fixed blurring while an upload was still running writing a half-finished path; it now refuses and removes the placeholder.
- Fixed a race where switching items before an upload finished wrote the result into the new item (stale-draft and ownership checks added).
- Fixed unchecking an image making it impossible to select again (selection was derived instead of tracked), and fixed "Cannot delete" being shown wrongly — deletability now depends only on whether another unfinished item references the image.
- The cleanup entry moved from an always-visible panel under the toolbar to a toolbar button plus a dedicated page: it no longer consumes vertical space and is no longer constrained by dialog width (the dialog previously showed a large empty area on the right and truncated text).
- Thumbnails are now complete and in their original aspect ratio; the checkbox sits above the thumbnail, clicking the thumbnail toggles deletion too, and the label is a fixed "Delete / Cannot delete" instead of changing with the selection state.

## Upgrade notes

Existing work items, execution slices, daily rhythm, Checklist and nutrition data are compatible and need no manual migration. The new image registration is stored in a new field (`imageCleanup`) of the existing work item structure, with defaults filled in when older data is read. Images live in the SiYuan asset library (`data/assets/`) and count toward your SiYuan cloud quota.
